_doc: Read-only sandbox inventory for `pnpm isometric:coverage-check -- --source=fixture` (ADR 0032). Each facility may supply reviewedLineSources keyed by live component ID (scope, entryPolicy, optional automaticSource). These explicit reviews override proposed contracts and use readiness/submission validation. Unknown fixture IDs fail; new live lines without a settled contract still need review. Entry-only operating lines warn; forbidden lines and unmapped inputs fail.
